articles.summary: We linked wearable and lab data from 16,760 people to see whether everyday physiological signals could flag who may benefit from metabolic screening. Using up to six months of device data collected before a first lab result, the model reached an AUC of 0.726 for glycemic dysregulation.
articles.title: Can Consumer Wearable Data Surface Metabolic Risk Before a Lab Test?

articles.summary: How trustworthy is your device data? Device Reliability shows whether Junction is receiving consistent data from every connected device, for every data type.
articles.title: Introducing Device Reliability in Junction Sense: Know Which Data You Can Trust
